weaknesses: The abstract misrepresents the contributions by discussing CRISPR-Cas9 instead of CipherChat.
Claims regarding the effectiveness of CipherChat are overstated; the results do not consistently demonstrate significant safety bypassing across all domains.
The novelty of the 'SelfCipher' approach is not adequately differentiated from existing methods that utilize role play or similar techniques.
Key assumptions about the generalizability of findings to other LLMs are not sufficiently supported by the experimental results.
strengths: The paper addresses a critical issue in LLM safety by exploring the vulnerabilities of models to non-natural language prompts.
The experimental design is comprehensive, covering multiple languages and safety domains, which adds depth to the findings.
The discussion on the implications of LLMs having a 'secret cipher' is intriguing and opens avenues for future research.
